extracted text: Typically, GeO₂ (0.208 g, 2 mmol) and NaOH (0.32 g, 8 mmol) were successively added into DETA (diethylenetriamine, 1.8 ml, 16 mmol) and pyridine (5 ml, 60 mmol). After vigorous stirring of about 4 h, the mixture with the molar ratio of 1 GeO₂: 4 NaOH: 8 DETA: 30 pyridine was sealed into the autoclave and put into the oven and heated at 180 °C for 7–8 days. The autoclave was naturally cooled to room temperature, and the light-yellow polyhedral crystals (~30% yield based on the GeO₂) were collected by filtering and washing by acetone and water.
